measurement.observed_useful_span_definition: last_meaningful_progress_at - substantive_work_started_at; diagnostic only, not proof of continuous work
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: Only evidenced useful intervals count. Sparse timestamps do not imply work between them.
measurement.window_useful_coverage_definition: sum of evidenced useful intervals inside the intended 900-second window, excluding unexplained gaps and known idle/waiting
measurement.dead_tail_definition: successor_observed_at - predecessor_last_meaningful_progress_at when both are known
measurement.target_operating_model: >=840s evidenced useful coverage per intended 900s window
measurement.feasibility_rule: If scheduler delivery delay + startup overhead exceeds 60 seconds in a non-overlapping 900-second window, a single worker cannot mathematically reach 840 useful seconds before the next quarter boundary; classify the window as scheduler-budget-constrained rather than blaming worker effort.

meaningful_outputs: draft PR #1 producer lane and generation proof
active_turn_observation.note: Even perfect continuous work from 00:46:24 to the 01:00 boundary can cover at most 816 seconds. This turn can still prove worker longevity and architecture progress, but cannot satisfy the 840-second single-window target without overlap or an earlier wake.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: Epoch 16 ended after 145 seconds. Epoch 17 has already extended meaningful span substantially, but its wake was observed 68 seconds after the intended 00:45 boundary and substantive work began 84 seconds after boundary, leaving only 816 seconds before 01:00.
latest_diagnosis.secondary_risk: A strict 840/900 target cannot be met by a non-overlapping single worker when prework delivery/startup loss exceeds 60 seconds, even if the worker then runs continuously.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Separating worker lifetime from wake delivery reveals two independent P0 constraints: worker span and scheduler budget.
next_corrective_experiment.change: Preserve long-objective execution while developing overlapping/event-driven wake layers; measure scheduler delivery and startup overhead explicitly.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: Future windows either start substantive work within <=60 seconds of intended boundary and sustain >=840 evidenced seconds, or use safe overlap/event continuation so delivery latency no longer consumes the entire utilization budget.
